GRADE 7 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — TERM 2 EXAM

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Time: 64 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Reading 4.2.1 Reading for information - Visuals in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. infer implied meaning of visuals for information,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 4.2.1 Reading for information - Visuals completely.
   C. Reading 4.2.1 Reading for information - Visuals is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 4.2.1 Reading for information - Visuals.

2. About Reading 4.2.1 Reading for information - Visuals when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. summarise written texts into visuals for comprehension,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 4.2.1 Reading for information - Visuals completely.
   C. Reading 4.2.1 Reading for information - Visuals is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 4.2.1 Reading for information - Visuals.

3. About Reading 4.2.1 Reading for information - Visuals while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. infer implied meaning of visuals for information,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 4.2.1 Reading for information - Visuals completely.
   C. Reading 4.2.1 Reading for information - Visuals is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 4.2.1 Reading for information - Visuals.

   A. outline the main features of a well-written dialogue,

   D. There is no need to practise Writing 4.3.1 Creative Writing – Dialogue.

   D. There is no need to practise Writing 4.3.1 Creative Writing – Dialogue.

   A. outline the main features of a well-written dialogue,

   C. Writing 4.3.1 Creative Writing – Dialogue is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 4.3.1 Creative Writing – Dialogue.

   A. apply the skimming strategy to identify the main idea in a text for comprehension,

29. About Writing 6.3.1 Essay writing – expository composition in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
